summary: Laird Superfood, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of all equity interests of Terrasoul Superfoods, LLC for $48.0M in cash, subject to customary adjustments, plus up to $5.0M in earnout based on 2026 contribution margin targets. Concurrently, Laird issued 60,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share for $60.0M to Gateway III and Gateway IV, using proceeds to fund the acquisition. The deal closed on April 21, 2026, with no disclosed board recommendation or advisors. The cash portion implies no premium based on a private target. Watch for the earnout achievement and the preferred stock's terms affecting equity value—risk-arb focuses on integration synergies and cash flow.
